maria (People Ops): quick kit — 15-minute manager goal kickoff + async feedback micro‑template. TL;DR: get alignment on outcome, 3 measurable results, owner signs, and a tiny first-week ask. paste into 1:1 or a kickoff thread.

maria (People Ops): ```Goal kickoff (15m)
Objective: <one-sentence outcome>
Outcome owner: <name>
Key results (3) - metric + baseline -> target:
  1) <metric> baseline -> target
  2) <metric> baseline -> target
  3) <metric> baseline -> target
Signals it's on track (3 short bullets)
Risks/blocks (short)
30/60/90 milestone snapshot (one line each)
First-week asks (what owner needs from manager/team)
Check-in cadence: weekly / bi-weekly / async updates
Success rubric: shipped vs impact vs learnings
```

maria (People Ops): quick canned prompts for async feedback you can paste under the kickoff or in a self-review thread: 
• "Top 1 thing I did to move this objective forward:"
• "One measurable win and evidence (link / number):"
• "What I would change if I had to do it again:"
• "Where I need help (specific ask):"

jordan (eng-manager): love this — can we add a tiny row for "ease of implementation" or "engineering effort" as a KR hint? helps prioritize tradeoffs.

maria (People Ops): good idea. add a quick effort hint under each KR: (effort: low/med/high). updated mental model.

lee (product): super helpful. also can we include a micro script for managers to run the 15m session? eg: 1) set outcome (3m) 2) pick KRs (6m) 3) agree signals & asks (4m) 4) confirm cadence (2m)

maria (People Ops): yep — paste this on the kickoff: 
"Manager 15m script: 0–3m set/confirm objective; 3–9m agree on 3 KRs + effort tags; 9–13m list signals/blocks & first-week asks; 13–15m confirm cadence + next check-in."

alex (hr-lead): flagging for managers — reuse these prompts for the self-review cycle and peer feedback. we'll add a one-click copy in the handbook. :bookmark_tabs:

sam (people-ops-bot): :white_check_mark: Pinned the template to #people-ops-resources and added a short link to the handbook (internal).

jordan (eng-manager): thanks all — copying into my 1:1 agenda for next week. quick Q: any recommended phrasing for upward feedback from IC -> manager?

maria (People Ops): short prompts for upward feedback: 
• "One thing my manager did this quarter that helped me deliver:"
• "One thing that would help me more going forward:"
• "Where I wish I had more context/decision rationale:"

maria (People Ops): final note — encourage managers to collect 2–3 concrete evidence items (links, numbers, short customer quotes) per KR for the review. keeps calibration factual and fast. :mag_right:

jordan (eng-manager): perfect. will trial and report back after the first round. :rocket:
